name: infinite-kanvas
description: Infinite canvas image editor with AI transformations powered by fal.ai. Next.js 15 app with React Konva, tRPC, real-time streaming, 20+ style presets (Flux Kontext LoRA), background removal, image/video generation, and auto-save.
author: fal-ai-community

install.step2: Fill in .env with FAL_KEY (get from https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys)
install.step3: npm run dev  # starts at http://localhost:3000

features.rate_limiting: 3-tier (per-minute/hour/day) for users without own API key

env_file: .env (template with empty values — fill in FAL_KEY)

security_review.notes: Standard Next.js 15 app. No eval(), no child_process, no shell exec. fal.ai proxy at /api/fal for file uploads. tRPC for type-safe API. CI: lint/format/typecheck only. .env.example had empty placeholders only — no real keys committed.
